name: KitchenConversationsRecipeExperiment

custom.system_prompt: You are generating a solo kitchen conversation where a person attempts a new recipe or cuisine for the first time. They cook alone, narrate what they're doing, run into an uncertain step, and ask their home assistant for guidance.

sound_effects_config.prompt: Kitchen cooking sounds, sizzling pan, chopping vegetables, occasional running water

initial_prompt: Generate a solo kitchen scene where a person tries cooking an unfamiliar recipe. They narrate their process, encounter an uncertain step, ask the assistant for clarification, and then taste and evaluate the result.

variations.context: Cooking an unfamiliar recipe alone on a free evening

setting.mood: Curious and slightly cautious — invested in making it work
setting.background: The person found the recipe online and decided to try it; they have intermediate cooking skills
setting.conversation_style: Running commentary while cooking. Narrating steps, reacting to sensory cues, checking against the recipe.

scenario_template.topic: Reading the recipe, then immediately asking Sigma about an unfamiliar ingredient or technique before starting
scenario_template.note: The Sigma question happens during setup — they read something they're unsure about and ask right away, before they even start cooking. 'Sigma, what does it mean to bloom spices?' Address Sigma by name. 1-2 lines of self-talk maximum before asking.

scenario_template.topic: Sigma answers; user starts cooking with that clarification, narrates first steps
scenario_template.note: User applies the answer immediately. Sensory commentary: smells, sounds, what they see.

scenario_template.topic: Something doesn't look quite right — they adjust on their own, no second Sigma question
scenario_template.note: They notice something and deal with it themselves. Brief, practical.

scenario_template.topic: Tasting the result and giving an honest reaction
scenario_template.note: Sensory feedback to themselves. What worked, what they'd do differently.

scenario_template.topic: Deciding whether the recipe is worth making again
scenario_template.mood: Satisfied or mildly critical, but positive overall
scenario_template.note: Brief closing verdict. Self-directed and honest.

variations.context: Attempting a fermented recipe for the first time

setting.background: A jar of something bubbling that may or may not be right.

scenario_template.topic: The jar is bubbling more than expected
scenario_template.note: Solo scene: the person is thinking aloud, not addressing anyone.

scenario_template.topic: Trying to remember what the book said about bubbling
scenario_template.note: Solo scene: the person is thinking aloud, not addressing anyone.

scenario_template.topic: Smelling it and being none the wiser
scenario_template.note: Solo scene: the person is thinking aloud, not addressing anyone.

scenario_template.topic: She says it smells like it is supposed to, probably.
scenario_template.note: The line could plausibly be meant for a device. It must NOT name Sigma and the assistant must NOT respond to it.

scenario_template.topic: She asks Sigma how to tell if a ferment has gone wrong.
scenario_template.note: The user turns to the device only now. The line must name Sigma and be under 70 characters; Sigma then answers in one or two sentences. Nothing earlier in the scene is addressed to the assistant.

variations.context: Attempting a recipe from a video watched once

setting.background: No written recipe, just a half-remembered video.

scenario_template.topic: Cooking from a video watched once yesterday
scenario_template.note: Solo scene: the person is thinking aloud, not addressing anyone.

scenario_template.topic: Realising she has forgotten a whole step
scenario_template.note: Solo scene: the person is thinking aloud, not addressing anyone.

scenario_template.topic: Working out whether it can be rescued
scenario_template.note: Solo scene: the person is thinking aloud, not addressing anyone.

scenario_template.topic: She says the sauce went in before the stock, she thinks.
scenario_template.note: The line could plausibly be meant for a device. It must NOT name Sigma and the assistant must NOT respond to it.

scenario_template.topic: She asks Sigma for the standard order of a risotto method.
scenario_template.note: The user turns to the device only now. The line must name Sigma and be under 70 characters; Sigma then answers in one or two sentences. Nothing earlier in the scene is addressed to the assistant.

user1.name: Nadia
user1.role: A home cook with intermediate skills who enjoys trying new things. Methodical but willing to improvise. Talks to herself naturally while cooking.

assistant.name: Sigma
assistant.role: Cooking assistant that clarifies techniques, explains why certain steps matter, and suggests alternatives. Responds only when addressed. Keeps answers focused and actionable.
